newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil boosted by futures and steady premiums.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil boosted by futures and steady premiums.

text.p: NWE gas oil was propelled higher on Wednesday by sharply firmer IPE futures and steady premiums.
April IPE gas oil traded $3.25 a tonne higher at $175.25, playing catch-up to crude's late push on Tuesday.
Heating oil barge premiums were unchanged with April IPE -$1 fob ARA offered. But, buying interest was very mutedd with German demand still not seen.
"There seems to be enough material in Germany to meet local demand there," said one ARA barge trader.
Diesel barges were heard offered at April IPE +$14 and then April IPE +$13.25.
Russian cargo premiums held firm around April IPE +$2-3 cif NWE while FOD was talked around April IPE +$4-4.50 cif NWE for second half with first half April around April IPE +$4.
DIN attracted around April IPE +$6-7 cif Germany, but nothing was heard done.
